2609.10239.title: LiteRAG: Cost-Efficient Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2609.10239.paper_summary: Graph-based retrieval can improve multi-hop question answering, but existing approaches often incur high query-time costs and produce diffuse, oversized contexts that reduce generation efficiency. We present LiteRAG, a graph-based retrieval method that replaces expensive retrieval-time LLM control with query-conditioned algorithmic exploration and reasoning-chain context construction. On DistComp, a benchmark for multi-hop retrieval over distributed-systems papers, LiteRAG attains the highest overall quality among the evaluated methods (0.798) while reducing per-query latency by over 100$\times$ and cost by over 99% relative to GraphRAG Global and DRIFT. On UltraDomain, it matches LinearRAG on overall quality while using about 14$\times$ fewer tokens. An ablation study indicates that LiteRAG's query-adaptive thresholding and community-aware hub penalization are the main drivers of its token-efficiency gains.
2609.10239.paper_summary_zh: 圖基檢索可以改善多跳問題回答，但現有的方法往往會產生高查詢時間成本，並產生擴散且過大的上下文，降低生成效率。我們提出了LiteRAG，一種圖基檢索方法，通過查詢條件的算法探索和推理鏈上下文構建，取代了昂貴的檢索時間LLM控制。在DistComp上，這是一個針對分佈式系統論文的多跳檢索基準，LiteRAG在評估的方法中達到了最高的整體質量（0.798），同時將每次查詢的延遲減少了超過100$\times$，並將成本相對於GraphRAG Global和DRIFT降低了超過99%。在UltraDomain上，它在整體質量上與LinearRAG相匹配，同時使用的標記數量約少了14$\times$。一項消融研究表明，LiteRAG的查詢自適應閾值和社區感知的中心懲罰是其標記效率增益的主要驅動因素。
